details: Each under 90 words, gives one useful tip first, then offers the free 3-slot cost pilot. No 'certified', no fake results, no pressure, no DM asks. Follow the opt-in rules in the offer pack.

title: Elephant-Goldfish review of 06-finops/PLAN.md: you are a zero-context goldfish reviewer
details: Follow the two EGM reviewer prompts given (zoom-out + implementation readiness). Read ONLY the plan text. Output: 1) up to 10 findings, each with severity (blocker/major/minor), the exact plan line it is about, and a one-line fix; 2) unstated assumptions; 3) open questions only Akhil can answer. Do not invent facts about the code; say UNVERIFIED where unsure. Plain short English.

title: Ledger Peaks dashboard + landing UX pattern audit
details: Audit this UI against the 20 Kalpa UX patterns in 00-hq/design/UX-PATTERNS.md. Output the per-UI table from that file (all 20 rows): for each pattern write done / not relevant (why) / missing, with the file and a short quote or line as evidence. You only see part of long files: anything you cannot see is UNVERIFIED, never guessed. Then list the top 5 missing patterns in fix order, each with a 1-2 line fix plan that uses the Kalpa design system (no new colours or fonts). Plain short English. No code longer than 10 lines.
